The following table presents the changes in Devon's total proved undeveloped reserves during 2013 (in MMBOE):

|   | U.S. | Canada | Total |
|---|---|---|---|

| Revisions other than price | (91) | 13 | (78) |
| Conversion to proved developed reserves | (116) | (31) | (147) |

At December 31, 2013, Devon had 701 MMBOE of proved undeveloped reserves. This represents a 17 percent decrease as compared to 2012 and represents 24 percent of total proved reserves. Drilling and development activities increased Devon's proved undeveloped reserves 95 MMBOE and resulted in the conversion of 147 MMBOE, or 18 percent, of the 2012 proved undeveloped reserves to proved developed reserves.
